propositions: The completion-verifier sidecar exposes only an aggregate `workflow_ms` label that obscures the operations responsible for hundreds of seconds and prevents performance diagnosis.

Instrumentation must add only monotonic in-process clock reads at existing call-path seams without introducing LLM calls, Git work, filesystem snapshots, network requests, retries, or subprocess activity.
Subphase durations grouped by `step_id` from the completion workflow recorder must sum with an explicit residual to exactly reconcile `workflow_ms` within documented rounding tolerance.
Existing aggregate fields and older sidecar records must remain backward compatible and parseable by the reusable duration probe.
Automated CI coverage must verify metric emission arithmetic, partition validation, and legacy sidecar compatibility without local resource constraints.
